title: Digital Director
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite; dist/index.html exists
checks.browser: Chromium via playwright-core against actual dist build
checks.overflow: passed: no document overflow; footer fits including 16px bottom padding
checks.fonts: Inter and basis33 loaded in both viewports
checks.video: Exact requested URL; readyState 4; 1920x1080; muted autoplay advances in both viewports; desktop scale 1.2
checks.interactions: Desktop navigation and showreel hover/fullscreen; mobile menu opens and closes using X, Escape, and navigation links
checks.visual_review: Desktop, mobile, and mobile menu screenshots reviewed

asset_issues: No unavailable assets or substitutions. Video and both fonts loaded successfully.
Chromium reported video net::ERR_ABORTED requests during the run; playback readiness and advancing time were verified independently. Raw requests retained in browser-report.json.
notes: Only Digital Director was read and implemented. No agents, other sessions, deployment, push, or messages.
Written prompt takes precedence over preview discrepancies. Reference was viewed only, with no asset extraction.
Service list line height is 1.45 on screens <=420px wide and <=860px tall to prevent footer clipping in the locked mobile viewport.
Navigation and call links retain prescribed # destinations. Showreel uses native fullscreen playback of the original video.
External fonts/video require network access. Screenshot video frames vary over time. Physical mobile browsers were not tested.
ready means ready for management review; not deployed.
